name: refine-bassline
about: One part refined over four turns.

steps.say: make a bassline on track 3
more syncopated
add a couple of slides
make it twice as long, with a different ending

name: plain-text-notes
about: A melody given as note names in text.

steps.say: play this on track 5 in eighth notes: C4 D4 E4 G4 E4 D4 C4 G3, then hold C4 for a bar

name: save-both
about: Saving, on the device and in the app.

steps.say: how do I save my project on the op-xy, and how do I keep this one from the app?

name: add-bar-lesson
about: A multi-step lesson followed by hand.

steps.say: make a 1 bar beat on track 1
teach me to add a second bar to it myself, light the keys
did it work? how many bars does it have now?

name: you-deleted-it
about: A user upset that a rewrite lost their beat.

steps.say: make a funky beat
now make a totally different beat
wait, you deleted my first beat! I wanted to keep it

name: hats-left
about: Panning one part of a kit.

steps.say: make a beat
put the hi-hats on the left

name: delay-snare-only
about: An effect on one sound of a kit.

steps.say: make a beat
put a delay on the snare only
make a synth pop beat with chords
make it sound more 80s

name: double-tempo-same
about: Tempo doubled, the music kept at the same speed.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass at 80 bpm
set it to 160 but keep it sounding the same speed
make a song with a verse and a chorus
make it end with a fade out

name: bass-follows-chords
about: A part derived from another track's chords.

steps.say: put Em C G D on track 7, a chord a bar
now write a bassline that follows those chords

name: what-did-i-make
about: The user's own key presses, explained.

steps.say: what did I just make?
make a song with an intro, a verse and a chorus
play the chorus twice before the verse comes back, and end on the intro

name: three-basslines
about: Options to choose between by ear.

steps.say: make a house beat
give me three different bassline ideas to pick from

name: drop-out-first-bar
about: A one-bar drop in a part.

steps.say: make a song with a verse and a chorus, 4 bars each
mute the drums for the first bar of the chorus only
how many patterns can one track have, and how long can a pattern be?
